analysis: Exploratory frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 on the same AZH training-pool blur folds
retrospective_status: Designed after original and blur results were visible; not preregistered.
test_archive_used: Read for exact deduplication only; no original-test predictions scored.

audit.dimension_flag: long side >700 px or short side >525 px, before fixed resize

protocol.encoder: Frozen ResNet-18 with identity classification layer
protocol.training: Clean inner data only; logistic head, temperature and selectors refit per fold.
protocol.preprocessing: EXIF transpose, RGB, 128-square bilinear resize, synthetic blur, 224-square bilinear resize, ImageNet normalisation.
protocol.coverage: Matched rankings are per fold and condition; thresholds are fixed from clean calibration scores.
protocol.limitations: Image-level folds, unknown patient overlap, synthetic blur, no clinical validation.
